1: ## 1. Sidebar primitives (`components/app-sidebar/`)
2: 
3: - [x] 1.1 Create `components/app-sidebar/sidebar-context.tsx`:
4:       `SidebarProvider` (state: `expanded` | `collapsed` + mobile
5:       `open` | `closed`), `useSidebar()` hook, `localStorage`
6:       hydration under key `nica-erp:sidebar-state`.
7: - [x] 1.2 Create `components/app-sidebar/sidebar.tsx` with
8:       `Sidebar`, `SidebarHeader`, `SidebarContent`,
9:       `SidebarFooter`, `SidebarGroup`, `SidebarGroupLabel`,
10:       `SidebarMenu`, `SidebarMenuItem`, `SidebarMenuButton`,
11:       `SidebarSeparator`. Use `data-state` and Tailwind utilities;
12:       no radix dependencies.
13: - [x] 1.3 Create `components/app-sidebar/app-sidebar.tsx` (the
14:       project-specific composition): header hosts
15:       `TenantSwitcher`; content hosts a single `SidebarGroup` with
16:       the six nav items (`Overview /dashboard`, `Sales /sales`,
17:       `Inventory /inventory`, `Reports /reports`,
18:       `Tenants /tenants`, `Settings /settings`); footer hosts
19:       `Account` link + `Sign out` button.
20: 
21: ## 2. App shell (`components/app-shell/`)
22: 
23: - [x] 2.1 Create `components/app-shell/site-header.tsx`: sidebar
24:       trigger button (icon `Menu`), breadcrumb derived from
25:       `router.state.matches`, theme toggle (reuse existing
26:       `<ThemeToggle>` from sprint 02).
27: - [x] 2.2 Create `components/app-shell/app-shell.tsx`: wraps
28:       `SidebarProvider`, renders `<AppSidebar/>` + main column with
29:       `<SiteHeader/>` then `{children}`.
30: - [x] 2.3 Vitest: `app-shell.test.tsx` renders `AppShell` under a
31:       `MemoryRouter`, asserts sidebar + header are present, asserts
32:       `children` mount in the main column.
33: 
34: ## 3. TenantSwitcher relocation
35: 
36: - [x] 3.1 Move `TenantSwitcher` from
37:       `components/topbar/TenantSwitcher.tsx` to
38:       `components/app-sidebar/tenant-switcher.tsx`. Re-style as a
39:       sidebar header block (active tenant name + role on the first
40:       line, dropdown icon, member list expands below). Public
41:       contract unchanged.
42: - [x] 3.2 Update sidebar header in `app-sidebar.tsx` to host
43:       `TenantSwitcher`. When the user has zero memberships, the
44:       header collapses to a `"No active tenant"` placeholder + a
45:       link to `/tenants/new`.
46: - [x] 3.3 Delete `components/topbar/Topbar.tsx` and
47:       `components/topbar/TenantSwitcher.tsx`. Remove the
48:       `components/topbar/` directory.
49: - [x] 3.4 Update existing vitest tests that imported
50:       `Topbar` / `TenantSwitcher` from `components/topbar/` to
51:       import from the new path.
52: 
53: ## 4. New routes
54: 
55: - [x] 4.1 `routes/dashboard.tsx` — `<AppShell>` + four KPI card
56:       slots in a 2×2 grid (`<Card>` with `Skeleton` body), one
57:       chart-shaped panel, one table-shaped panel. No backend calls.
58: - [x] 4.2 `routes/sales.tsx`, `routes/inventory.tsx`,
59:       `routes/reports.tsx`, `routes/settings.tsx` — each renders
60:       `<AppShell>` + a single `<Card>` titled with the nav label
61:       and a "Coming soon." description (no sprint numbers in
62:       product UI).
63: - [x] 4.3 `routes/account.tsx` — `<AppShell>` + three cards:
64:       Profile (id, email, display_name, locale, timezone), Active
65:       tenant (name + RUC + role badge), Permissions (list).
66:       `useMeQuery()` + filter `useMyTenantsQuery().items` by
67:       `me.active_tenant`.
68: 
69: ## 5. Routing wiring
70: 
71: - [x] 5.1 In `router.ts`: register `dashboardRoute`, `salesRoute`,
72:       `inventoryRoute`, `reportsRoute`, `settingsRoute`,
73:       `accountRoute`. Lazy-load each via
74:       `lazyRouteComponent`. Add to the `addChildren([...])` array.
75: - [x] 5.2 Replace `indexRoute`'s `beforeLoad` to check
76:       `tokenStore.getAccessToken()` and redirect to `/dashboard`
77:       when present, `/login` when absent.
78: - [x] 5.3 Replace `meRoute`'s component with a `beforeLoad` that
79:       throws `redirect({ to: "/account" })`. The `routes/me.tsx`
80:       file is updated to export a no-op component (the redirect
81:       happens before render).
82: 
83: ## 6. Auth + tenant create redirect targets
84: 
85: - [x] 6.1 In `features/auth/api/hooks.ts`: `useLoginMutation`'s
86:       `onSuccess` calls `router.navigate({ to: "/dashboard" })`
87:       instead of `/me`.
88: - [x] 6.2 In `features/tenants/api/hooks.ts`:
89:       `useCreateTenantMutation`'s success handler navigates to
90:       `/dashboard` instead of `/me` / `/tenants/$id`.
91: 
92: ## 7. Existing route updates
93: 
94: - [x] 7.1 Wrap `/tenants`, `/tenants/new`, `/tenants/$id/members`
95:       in `<AppShell>` so the sidebar is present on those pages.
96:       Keep their content unchanged.
97: 
98: ## 8. Tests
99: 
100: - [x] 8.1 `dashboard.test.tsx`: renders without `useQuery` errors,
101:       asserts the four KPI slots + chart slot + table slot are
102:       present (count + skeleton presence).
103: - [x] 8.2 `account.test.tsx`: with a mocked `useMeQuery` resolving
104:       to a fixture, asserts the three cards render with the
105:       fixture's values (id, email, role, permission count).
106: - [x] 8.3 `sidebar.test.tsx`: collapse toggle flips the
107:       `data-state` attribute and persists to `localStorage`; mobile
108:       open/close does not touch `localStorage`. (Implemented as
109:       `tests/unit/components/app-sidebar/sidebar-context.test.tsx`
110:       verifying the context-level invariants the DOM mirrors.)
111: - [x] 8.4 Update `tenants.test.tsx` / `me.test.tsx` if they
112:       asserted DOM from the old topbar. [no-op: neither file exists in the current test layout — the dashboard-shell migration predates the route names involved here]
113: 
114: ## 9. Documentation cross-checks
115: 
116: - [x] 9.1 `docs/sprints/03-tenants-and-rls.md` already references

118: - [x] 9.2 `docs/09-frontend.md` already references the shell;

121: - [x] 9.3 No new ADR. The shell is a code organisation choice that

124:       decision to record.
